how?
how? It is placed mostly at the beginning of a sentence, more rarely in the middle, or at the end.
In an indirect question.

and it is placed either alone or with other particles added, such as πῶς ἄν [how then], πῶς δ᾽ ἄν [but how then], πῶς ἄρα [how then], πῶς γάρ [for how], πῶς δέ [but how], πῶς δή [how indeed], πῶς δῆτα [how in the world], πῶς δ᾽ οὔ [how not], πῶς δ᾽ οὐχί [how not], and what is most frequent, καὶ πῶς [and how], where the words of the previous person are continued. Examples of every kind are these:
Thus Blomfield for ἄν πως [somehow].
restored by Askew for πῶ πῶ [how? how?].
where the other person answers ἢ πῶς ; λέγ᾽ αὖθις, ὡς μάθω σαφέστερον [or how? speak again, so that I may learn more clearly], where Valckenaer rightly corrected to ὅπως [so that].
where Hermann conjectured κρατεῖ ται δ᾽ ἔπος [the word prevails].
where Abresch rightly [conjectured] ἀλλ᾽ ἁπλῶς [but simply].
